consequence.statement: This is a new optional capability (support for mTLS on the GitHub App transport). The evidence does not say any existing behaviour changes.

assertion.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for mTLS on the GitHub App transport used by GitRepository, ImageUpdateAutomation and Provider.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence does not name the field or setting that turns on mTLS for the GitHub App transport, so no exposure condition can be written; it is a new capability, and nothing says existing configurations are affected.
